page_title: ANG 0-2 BRE | Angers v Brest 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Joris Chotard (Brest) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+4' Florent Hanin (Angers) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
90+3' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. Angers have a corner.
90+3' Louis Mouton (Angers) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Florent Hanin (Angers) launches a cross from the corner, but Radoslaw Majecki is alert to thwart the effort.
89' Substitution. Romain Del Castillo makes way for Luc Zogbe (Brest).
88' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
86' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) picks up an injury.
85' Prosper Peter (Angers) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
84' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
83' Willy Delajod blows his whistle as Lanroy Machine (Angers) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
81' Michel Diaz Jr. (Brest) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
79' The game has come to an end for Yassine Belkhdim. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marius Courcoul (Angers).
79' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Louer (Angers) replacing Carlens Arcus.
76' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Angers.
75' Substitution. Kamory Doumbia walks off the pitch and Junior Dina Ebimbe (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
75' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Joris Chotard (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

73' Well-positioned Kamory Doumbia (Brest) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Herve Koffi reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
72' Flag goes up against Lanroy Machine (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
70' Substitution. Louis Mouton (Angers) in, Himad Abdelli out.
70' Here is a change. Sidiki Cherif is going off and Alexandre Dujeux gives the last tactical orders to Lanroy Machine (Angers).
69' Half-chance! Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) plays a pass into the box, but Radoslaw Majecki reacts well to snuff out the attack.
68' The players claim that Prosper Peter (Angers) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
67' Substitution. Florent Hanin (Angers) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jacques Ekomie walks off.
66' Wasted opportunity. Jordan Lefort (Angers) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
66' Himad Abdelli (Angers) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
63' Remy Labeau Lascary is being substituted because of an injury. Eric Roy sends Pathe Mboup (Brest) on the pitch.
62' Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
61' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Romain Del Castillo (Brest).

59' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brest.
57' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

57' A pass lands at the feet of Sidiki Cherif (Angers) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Angers are going to take it.

54' Prosper Peter (Angers) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the top right corner. Radoslaw Majecki displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

52' Bradley Locko (Brest) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
48' A rebound spins to Sidiki Cherif (Angers) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brest will have a goal kick.
48' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Half-time substitution. Alexandre Dujeux decided to make a change. Ousmane Camara is replaced by Emmanuel Biumla (Angers).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Some neat passing and movement from Brest as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
44' Herve Koffi (Angers) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
44' The corner from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) is intercepted by Herve Koffi.
43' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) receives a nice pass from the free kick and strikes from the edge of the box, but his attempt hits one of the defenders and bounces away off him.
41' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
40' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
40' Himad Abdelli (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
38' Himad Abdelli (Angers) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

34' The cross into the penalty area from Romain Del Castillo (Brest) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
32' 0 - 2 Goal! Romain Del Castillo (Brest) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Herve Koffi to commit before slotting the penalty into the middle of the goal.
32' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
32' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. PENALTY to Brest! Great chance to score.
29' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Ludovic Ajorque (Brest).

26' 0 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Remy Labeau Lascary (Brest) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
26' Himad Abdelli (Angers) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
23' The corner by Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.

23' Himad Abdelli (Angers) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Angers have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Corner kick. Angers will have an opportunity.
22' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.

21' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
21' Haris Belkebla (Angers) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
20' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
17' Brest hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
15' Justin-Noel Kalumba (Angers) takes the corner which is cleared.

15' Carlens Arcus (Angers) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Angers.
11' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul.
9' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
8' Himad Abdelli (Angers) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
7' Himad Abdelli (Angers) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
6' The ball is behind the sideline. Bradley Locko (Brest) takes a throw-in.
4' Rough tackle by Joris Chotard (Brest). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Herve Koffi is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Kenny Lala (Brest). Easy save!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Angers will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will referee today's match.
